name: Yakushima
description: Yakushima is a round, mountainous island off the southern tip of Kyushu, in Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. Its misty interior shelters a remnant of ancient warm-temperate forest, where some 1,900 plant species and subspecies grow among giant, centuries-old sugi cedars. Spread over about 505 square kilometres, it is reachable by ferry or a short flight, and hikers come to walk among the moss-covered trees.
